caption: The drawing depicts a wooden sideboard with a rich brown color, featuring six slender legs and a serpentine front edge. The sideboard has a symmetrical design with two large cabinet doors in the center, flanked on each side by two drawers, one above the other, and a smaller single drawer at each top corner, making a total of four drawers above and two larger compartments below. Each drawer and compartment has a silver or metallic pull handle, depicted as half-moon-shaped with fine detailing. The wood grain is visible, and there are lighter brown or golden accents outlining the panels and edges of the drawers and doors. Below the sideboard, at the center of the image, there is a detailed drawing of an individual handle, shown enlarged to display its intricate decoration, including a festoon motif and a textured border. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the objects are enclosed within a subtle rectangular outline.
title: Side Board (Hepplewhite)
